title: Free school meals, in a rural district (an invented example)
about: Everything here is invented to show how a question is worked: the studies and their effects, the district, the costs and the worths. No study named here exists. A theory with two paths from the meal to learning, a body of evidence on every link, trials of the whole intervention, and a decision that is close enough for a study to be worth running first.
